title: Combat Just Changed in Dragonwilds - Update 1.0.1
author: SuperStooob
chapters: Rune Arrow and Bolt Damage Buff
Dorgeshuun vs Blurite vs Rune Crossbow

Raid Skips and Ore Respawn Fixes
Enemy Aggro, Respawns and Combat Fixes
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 brings new ranged special attacks, dedicated ring and amulet slots, a 40-slot inventory, and some easily missed changes to farming and raid routes.

Here’s what the update looks like in-game, including the rune arrow and bolt damage buff, Amulet of Glory nerf, Windstep plunge attack, and Kuldra’s ascension core drops. I also compare early crossbow results and check what’s changed for the Crystal Bow and Bow of Elidinis.

These are first-day comparisons. I’m doing a 24-hour stream this weekend for a full run-through with the update, then following up with more informed weapon and build recommendations.
